'''Mena''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] resident of [[Makeb]] and one of the few able to operate the [[Argent Sky Lancers]] orbital satellites. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]] in [[3638 BBY]], the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] hired the [[InterStellar Regulators]] to force Mena, her friend [[Kai Teyun]] and the others to turn the lasers to the surface and fire on anything [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] deemed hostile. Mena refused to cooperate and was killed by the Regular thugs.
